ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC: PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], Administrative Measures for the Filing of Beneficial Ownership Information, effective 1 November 2024; Taiwan: Money Laundering Control Act, as amended, and its AML/CFT enforcement rules; Taiwan Company Act Article 22-1; Foreign Investment Act; Regulations Governing the Approval of Foreign Investment.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the PRC investing parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) where the PRC parent is registered
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille Convention member; use the consular/cross-strait legalization path only: notarized true copy by a PRC notary public; authenticated by the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC; certified by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) in Taiwan; filed with MOEA. Do not apostille. Do not chain apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the PRC investing parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation or local Market Regulation Bureau; tax good standing obtained from the local State Taxation Administration bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Destination is a non-Hague state; use PRC notarization, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, then SEF certification in Taiwan. A Hague apostille is not accepted for Taiwan. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain them.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing Taiwan JV formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the PRC investing parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC-origin instrument: notarize the resolution, signatures, and company seal before a PRC notary public; authenticate through the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs; certify through the Straits Exchange Foundation in Taiwan; submit to MOEA. If an ancillary document originates in a Hague state, obtain that state's apostille for that ancillary document only; do not append Taiwan consular legalization to an apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the proposed Taiwan joint venture
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporators and founding shareholders of the Taiwan JV, notarized by a Taiwan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin instrument: notarize signatures and seals before a Taiwan district notary public and file directly with MOEA. Annexed PRC shareholder resolutions, if any, follow PRC notarization, PRC MFA authentication, and SEF certification. This is a consular/cross-strait path, not a Hague apostille path; do not chain methods.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the PRC investing parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PBOC-regulated commercial bank maintaining the PRC parent's primary account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank seal notarized by a PRC notary public, authenticated by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs, certified by SEF, and delivered to the Taiwan commercial bank for AML/KYC. Taiwan does not accept a Hague apostille for this document; use the consular legalization path only and do not combine with apostille.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Screen all directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorized signatories, and senior managers against OFAC SDN and consolidated lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, HMT sanctions, EU consolidated lists, Taiwan FIU-designated terrorist lists, and PRC sanctions and export-control lists. Politically exposed persons (PEPs), including foreign and domestic PEPs and their close associates, require enhanced due diligence: source-of-wealth verification, source-of-funds documentation, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. Negative news and adverse media checks are mandatory. Any sanctions hit must be reported immediately to the Taiwan Financial Intelligence Unit and the relevant authority; no incorporation step may proceed until compliance clears the subject.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Company and Commerce Registration Information System (CCRIS) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, including the Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Review subsystem
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in Chinese; an English transliteration may be registered as a secondary name but has no statutory status. Name architecture uses four tiers: distinguishing name, business-scope descriptor, legal-form suffix indicating limited company or company limited by shares, and, for foreign investors, a Mandarin phonetic transliteration approved by MOEA. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name for the same or similar business scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days of receipt, attaching the rejection letter, the original name-reservation application, a comparison chart showing non-conflicting names, and legal grounds. MOEA must decide within three months; silence constitutes denial, after which the applicant may bring administrative litigation in the Taipei High Administrative Court. The reservation may be extended once for 180 days by a written application filed before expiry. A fresh name-reservation application should be filed concurrently with the appeal to preserve the transaction timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected by Taiwan's National Taxation Bureau and commercial banks for a passive equity-holding SPV. Registry filing may accept a service address only at the pre-incorporation stage, but tax registration, uniform invoice registration, and bank account opening require a genuine physical office evidenced by a lease contract, utility bills, signage, and local substance. The physical office must be disclosed to the tax bureau, and any supplemental mail-forwarding arrangement must be separately reported to the bank for AML processing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: registered office signage, lease agreement, rent receipts, utility bills, local staff presence or identification records, statutory books and meeting minutes, and current bank statements. Quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection by the National Taxation Bureau or MOEA within the first 12 months: 80-90% for a virtual-office-only arrangement; 25-35% for a shared physical office without local employees; 10-15% for a dedicated office with substantive local personnel and timely filings.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), as amended, Articles 129 (Articles of Incorporation), 154-155 (Share Capital and Shareholder Liability), 172-194 (Board of Directors), 199-200 (Supervisor Election), 387-388 (Registration Requirements) and 10 (Registered Office). Further, the Foreign Investment Regulations (外國人投資條例) administered by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Section, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Establishment Registration (公司設立登記申請書) accompanied by the Articles of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under Taiwan Company Act, there is no statutory minimum paid-in capital for a limited liability company; the paid-in capital must be at least equal to the issued share capital declared in the Articles of Incorporation and may be evidenced by a capital verification bank statement. No blocked escrow account is statutorily required unless the foreign investment approval imposes capital injection conditions; in that case, the foreign investor's remitted funds must be cleared through the Central Bank of China (Taiwan) foreign exchange approval process.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
I, Cheng Wei-Lin, being the duly appointed chairperson of the board of directors of SinFuture Equity Holding Limited (the Company), a limited company organized under the Taiwan Company Act, do hereby declare that the following written resolution was duly proposed, seconded, adopted and approved by unanimous vote of the sole director and shareholders acting by written consent on 20 March 2025, and I certify that the adoption of such resolution constitutes a lawful record of corporate determination and direction.

RESOLVED, that the share capital of the Company be and the same is hereby subscribed and accepted in accordance with the Articles of Incorporation; that the binding commitments to pay for all issued ordinary shares as set forth in the capitalization schedule be hereby ratified and confirmed; and that the chairman be and the same is hereby authorized to receive funds and to execute and deliver any document evidencing the lawful issue and allotment of shares.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the statutory books and bank accounts of the Company be opened with Cathay United Bank, Taipei Main Branch; that the signatories for corporate accounts shall be the chairman, finance director and any one jointly; and that the bank be and the same is hereby authorized to honor all checks, drafts, wire transfer instructions, and written payment orders signed by said signatories, including SWIFT wire transfers and traditional interbank transfers.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office and legal seat of the Company be and the same is hereby established and fixed at 10F., No. 88, Section 2, Keelung Road, Xinyi District, Taipei City 11008, Taiwan; that the registered address documents and power of attorney be filed with the Commercial Registration Section, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs; and that the registered office shall serve as the principal place of administration and statutory address for service of process.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following statutory officers be and the same are hereby appointed for the first three years, namely: (i) the Chairperson and Director; (ii) two additional directors; (iii) one supervisor; and (iv) the Corporate Secretary, with full power to execute all filings, notices, minutes, declarations and returns necessary for the Company's regulatory compliance; and that each officer shall, upon their written undertaking, exercise the duties of loyalty and care under Taiwan Company Act.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that this resolution shall be effective immediately, that nothing in this resolution shall repeal or modify the Articles of Incorporation, and that all prior acts taken in anticipation of the incorporation are hereby retroactively validated and ratified. The Chairperson is directed to cause this resolution to be recorded in the minutes and served on the governmental authorities as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Pre-Reservation and SPV Name Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Search and Registration Section, Commercial Registration Department, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taipei, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an exhaustive corporate name search of the Taiwan Company Name Database using four exact names and one transliterated English name for the proposed holding SPV, namely SinFuture Taiwan Holding Ltd. and three alternate names, each ending with the Taiwan corporate designation Limited. The designated company secretary shall complete the online MOEA Name Pre-Reservation Application, attach the shareholder identification proofs and preliminary Articles of Incorporation, and pay the name reservation fee. The MOEA examiner will verify that no identical or confusingly similar name exists in the same business classification, and will reserve the name for an initial exclusive period of six months. The submission must be fully digitally signed in the notarial cloud or physically notarized in the Taipei City Commercial Notary Office. No corporate powers may be exercised until the reservation certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: Digital/notarized Articles of Incorporation preliminary draft
Shareholder identification documents of all founding members
Original email and phone consent for corporate registers
Name Reservation Application Form
Power of Attorney for company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected for similarity or non-compliance, the applicant may cure by filing an administrative motion for reconsideration within 20 days, submitting a rebuttal evidence package and two amended name alternatives without additional fee, or by refiling under a distinct transliteration with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Commission Foreign Investment Approval (for PRC and Non-Resident Equity Holders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Where a mainland China enterprise or non-resident shareholder subscribes to shares in the Taiwanese holding SPV, the applicant must obtain a foreign investor pre-approval before the company can complete registration. The designated legal counsel shall file an electronic Investment Approval Application specifying the proposed share allocation, funding source statements, and the holding target structure of the SPV. The Investment Commission will screen the investment for national security, real estate, and prohibited-sector sensitivities. If the holding SPV is passive and not engaged in manufacturing, no sector-specific restriction normally applies. Upon approval, the applicant receives an Investment Approval Letter, which must be attached to the final Company Registration application. Any modification of shareholding ratio or funding source after approval requires a prior amendment filing. The timeline and SLA recover by applicant's responsiveness to supplementary review.
required_dossiers: Investment Application Form FDI-01
Audited financial or tax certificate of the foreign investor
Notarized Power of Attorney to counsel
Capital flow statement and source declaration
Projected business plan for passive holding activities
Shareholders meeting or board resolution of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a query or intends to reject, the applicant has a statutory period of 30 days to submit an amended proposal, revised funding structure, or written explanations; an oral hearing may be requested, and any rejection may be appealed to the MOEA Departmental Appeal Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration and Issuance of Corporate Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Section, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon name reservation and investment approval, the applicant must file the formal Company Establishment Registration Application with the MOEA Department of Commerce, tendering the final Articles of Incorporation, the account-opening capital verification certificate from the appointed bank, the signed first board resolution appointing officers, the investment approval letter, and the name reservation certificate. MOEA will issue a corporate registration certificate and a unified business tax number after verifying no inconsistencies in the corporate address, the director/supervisor identification, and the capital certificate. Once the registration certificate is received, the company is deemed a legal person and may open interbank and SWIFT banking facilities, execute all contracts and maintain litigation rights solely in its own name. The certificate should be retained faithfully in the company records.
required_dossiers: Original MOEA Name Reservation Certificate
Fully executed Articles of Incorporation
Capital Verification Bank Certificate or Paid-In Capital Receipt
Investment Approval Letter
Pro-forma First Board Resolution and minutes
Directors and supervisors identification verification copies
Registered office consent letter/lease
Company Registration Application Form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA suspends the application for incomplete dossiers, the applicant has 15 days to rectify by filing the missing original or notarized copies; repeated suspension may be cured by a formal administrative appeal or by reworking the filings under Article 388 of the Company Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Registration and Corporate Seal / Banking Accreditation Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of Taipei (NTBT) and Bank of Taiwan / Cathay United Bank Corporate Banking Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the MOEA issuance of the corporate certificate, the company must complete the registration for profit-seeking enterprise income tax, withholding tax, and issuance of a uniform invoice serial code at the National Taxation Bureau of Taipei (NTBT) within 30 days. The corporate seal registration, schedule of board signatories and a specimen of the company seal must be lodged with the bank. After a positive corporate in-branch due diligence interview, the bank will activate the restricted corporate and escrow accounts and issue the corporate internet banking tokens, including SWIFT wire execution privileges. The procedure also includes an AML beneficial ownership declaration and completion of the required tax-free asset transfer statement where applicable.
required_dossiers: MOEA Company Registration Certificate
Corporate seal registration form and board authorization
Bank tax declaration card and Uniform Invoice Code application
AML/KYC declaration of ultimate beneficial owner
First Board Resolution banking authority extract
Lease agreement for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau identifies a data mismatch, the taxpayer may file a written amendment or administrative reconsideration within 30 days; for bank rejection on the ground of AML suspicion, a re-submission of beneficial ownership documents and transaction justification may cure the decision, or a letter of remedial legal advice may be obtained from counsel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — the SPV is a pure equity holding company under ISIC 6420 and NAICS 551112, with no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, warehousing, or physical production establishment; no industrial licensing board approval is required.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — no operational manufacturing, trading, or warehousing permit is required for passive holding of subsidiary shares and collection of dividends.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable — no physical facility, pollution discharge, or land alteration is connected to the registered office; no project declaration, environmental registration, or full EIA report is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — the SPV has no wastewater discharge, VOC emission, or hazardous waste generation; therefore no numeric thresholds under Taiwan Water Pollution Control Act, Air Pollution Control Act, or Waste Management Act apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable — the entity operates purely as a registered office, does not maintain a factory or chemical plant; Civil Defense fire safety certification, structural load inspections and occupational safety approvals under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, Taiwan, are not triggered. Any future physical establishment will require a separate mandatory certificate.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taxation Administration (財政部賦稅署) as the national tax policy and interpretation authority; operational administration by the five National Taxation Bureaus (各地區國稅局) of the Ministry of Finance; customs and export controls by the Customs Administration (財政部關務署); unified e-portal: 財政部稅務入口網 (https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw); e-invoice platform: 財政部電子發票整合服務平台 (https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Obtain foreign investment approval from the MOEA Investment Commission (投資審議司) under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals. Step 2: Complete company incorporation (公司登記) with the Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部) under the Company Act; the Taiwan-incorporated limited-liability company form is registered for this JV SPV. Step 3: The Ministry of Finance automatically assigns the 8-digit Unified Business Number (統一編號) through government data exchange upon completion of company registration. Step 4: File business/tax registration (營業登記/稅籍登記) with the competent National Taxation Bureau before commencing any taxable activity, submitting the incorporation certificate, foreign investment approval letter, business premises documentation, and Articles of Incorporation; the application may be filed online via the e-Tax portal. Step 5: A purely passive holding SPV with no Taiwan-source business activity must still obtain a tax file and, where applicable, a withholding unit TIN (扣繳單位統一編號); a foreign enterprise without a registered branch must appoint a withholding agent and register the agent for TIN purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: A Taiwan-incorporated company is a separate taxpayer under the Income Tax Act (所得稅法), subject to Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax at 20% on net worldwide income if resident in Taiwan. For a pure equity-holding SPV, dividends received from a domestic profit-seeking enterprise are exempt from the income tax base under Article 42 of the Income Tax Act where the shares are directly held at or above 20% and continuously for at least 12 months; this exemption does not alter the entity-level classification. No pass-through treatment is available to limited companies; the corporate liability shield is respected. Territorial scope: resident status attaches to companies incorporated or having their head office in Taiwan; non-resident foreign corporations are taxed only on Taiwan-source income via branch filing or withholding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or free entity-classification election exists under Taiwan domestic law; tax classification is governed by the Company Act form. Available elections: (1) election of small-scale trader treatment at the 1% Business Tax rate where average monthly sales do not exceed TWD 80,000 (Article 13, Business Tax Act); (2) election to carry forward net operating losses for up to 10 years under Article 39 of the Income Tax Act, conditioned on approved financial accounts and records; (3) election to claim investment tax credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation for qualifying R&D, smart machinery, and green energy equipment; (4) election of standard 5% VAT filing where a business would otherwise fall under the small-scale trader regime; (5) election to apply for input VAT refund on zero-rated export transactions under Article 39 of the Business Tax Act; (6) no consolidated or group income tax election is available to ordinary holding companies; hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized in Taiwan domestic law, and any cross-border mismatch outcome is governed by the applicable bilateral tax treaty.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Business Tax (加值型及非加值型營業稅) — value-added tax regime under the Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Act (營業稅法)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: TWD — No statutory de minimis turnover threshold for ordinary Business Tax registration; every business selling goods or services in Taiwan must complete 稅籍登記 before commencement (Article 28, Business Tax Act). Special regimes: small-scale traders (小規模營業人) with average monthly sales below or equal to TWD 80,000 (approximately TWD 960,000 per annum) are taxed at 1% on deemed revenue and may be exempted from issuing uniform invoices; businesses with monthly sales between TWD 80,001 and TWD 200,000 pay 1% unless they elect standard 5% VAT accounting. A pure equity-holding SPV receiving only exempt dividend income is outside the Business Tax sales base and is not required to file periodic VAT returns, but must complete 稅籍登記 or be registered as a withholding entity if it maintains a Taiwan business presence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory digital e-invoicing (電子發票): all VAT-registered enterprises must issue e-invoices through the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Integrated Platform (財政部電子發票整合服務平台) or a certified Value-Added Center (加值中心) using Turnkey/API interfaces. Issuance data must be uploaded to the platform within 48 hours of invoice issuance for B2B and B2C invoices; B2C carrier (載具) storage and the Uniform Invoice Lottery are integrated. Export zero-rated sales must be declared in the periodic Business Tax return together with the zero-rated sales register (零稅率銷售額清單); customs export declaration data are automatically transmitted from the Customs Administration to the National Taxation Bureau. Failure to timely upload e-invoice data is subject to penalties under Articles 48 and 52 of the Business Tax Act.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 7 of the Business Tax Act grants a 0% rate to: (1) goods physically exported, supported by a customs export declaration; (2) services supplied to foreign enterprises for use wholly outside Taiwan with consideration paid in foreign currency and actually received in Taiwan; (3) international transportation services; (4) services rendered to foreign vessels and aircraft; (5) sales to duty-free shops, foreign embassies, and international organizations; (6) goods and services directly related to export transactions. A pure equity-holding SPV may claim zero-rating on qualifying offshore management, advisory, or administrative services only if a written service contract exists, a zero-rated uniform invoice is issued, foreign-currency consideration is received and credited in Taiwan, and the economic use of the service occurs wholly outside Taiwan. Dividend receipts are not 'sales of goods or services' and are therefore outside the Business Tax base: they generate neither output VAT nor zero-rated output tax.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口報單) authenticated by the Customs Administration
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (提單/空運提單) evidencing physical export
Inward Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate (結匯水單) or bank statement evidencing receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
Commercial Invoice (商業發票) issued in the contract currency
Zero-Rated Sales Register (零稅率銷售額清單) filed with the periodic Business Tax return
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Joint audits by the National Taxation Bureau and the Customs Administration compare customs export declarations, e-invoice data, foreign-exchange receipts, and bank flows. If zero-rating is claimed without physical export, with misdeclared goods or services, or in respect of export proceeds not repatriated within the statutory period, the VAT is retrospectively clawed back with interest. Article 51 of the Business Tax Act imposes a penalty of up to 5 times the evaded tax; Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act, as amended in 2021, imposes criminal liability of up to 7 years' imprisonment for fraudulent evasion. The statutory assessment period is 7 years for non-filing or fraudulent cases and 5 years for ordinary under-declarations (Article 21, Tax Collection Act); repeated offenses may result in suspension or revocation of the exporter's customs registration and loss of zero-rating privileges.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Officer/Major Shareholder Declaration (Company Act Article 22-1)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Company Registration Online System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January each year for the preceding calendar year; update within 15 days after any change to directors, supervisors, managers, or members holding 10% or more
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of TWD 50,000 to TWD 500,000, followed by a correction deadline; repeated non-compliance triggers recurring per-instance fines and may lead to a MOEA dissolution order under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements, business report, and profit-distribution or loss-absorption proposal approved by shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders (written consent or shareholders' meeting); executed records retained at registered office and open to MOEA inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the fiscal year end (by 30 June for calendar-year companies); MOEA may grant an extension on application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible directors are subject to administrative fines for failure to convene or circulate annual accounts; continued default or inactivity for more than six consecutive months may support MOEA compulsory dissolution under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return and annual financial statement attachment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance (local filing or online system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the year immediately following the taxable year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a 10% late-report surcharge on tax due (minimum TWD 1,500) plus interest; failure to file after an assessment investigation incurs a 15% negligence surcharge; intentional evasion may lead to criminal prosecution under the Tax Evasion Penalty Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: CPA audit is mandatory where paid-in capital equals or exceeds TWD 30 million, or where the MOEA or another competent authority expressly requires audited financial statements; pure equity holding SPVs below this threshold may prepare unaudited statements unless a parent/subsidiary consolidation rule or regulator imposes a higher threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS/IAS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for public issuers; non-public companies use Enterprise Accounting Standards (Taiwan local GAAP) under the Business Entity Accounting Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act Article 22-1, the company must annually confirm and file with MOEA the register of directors, supervisors, managers, and members holding 10% or more, including beneficial ownership indicators; any member capital transfer or control change must be reported within 15 days. The secretary must reconcile the Register of Members and minute-book records before the annual 31 January declaration.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Pure equity-holding SPV generally derives only exempt dividend income under Article 42 of the Income Tax Act; no operational corporate income tax on exempt dividends. Retained earnings surtax of 5% applies to undistributed earnings, creating an effective combined rate of up to 24.64% on distributed corporate profits when considering the imputation system. Investment tax credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation (SII) are generally unavailable for passive holding activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書) Form 17 / Form 17A; filed electronically via the Ministry of Finance electronic tax-filing portal (電子申報繳稅服務網站) or approved e-filing intermediaries.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within five months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., by May 31 for calendar-year taxpayers. Quarterly advance payments (估計暫繳) are due September 30 for companies with prior-year taxable income, but a pure holding SPV with no taxable income is generally exempt from interim filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross revenue; for a pure holding SPV, revenue is normally zero. Exempt dividend income under Article 42 is reported separately on Schedule 5 as non-taxable income, not as gross revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not file Form 17; the Taiwan-resident SPV acts as withholding agent on distributions to non-residents. For the SPV itself, report only Taiwan-source operational revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 17 Line 4 / Box 04 (Cost of Goods Sold)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: For an equity holding SPV, cost of goods sold is zero unless the entity derives service or trading income outside the passive holding scope.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the SPV is a pure holding company, no COGS entry. Non-resident parent should ensure no intercompany cost allocations without transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report deductible administrative expenses: audit, legal, registered office, bank fees, local directors' remuneration. Support with invoices and withholding tax certificates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid to the Chinese parent are deductible only if arm's length, supported by a Taiwan transfer pricing report, and subject to applicable withholding (20% or treaty rate, unless a Taiwan branch of the foreign recipient).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 17 Line 8 / Box 08 (Non-operating Income and Gains)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report interest income, FX gains, and other non-operating income. Dividends from the China subsidiary are tax-exempt under Article 42 if the SPV holds at least 20% equity for at least 12 months; record in the exempt income memorandum account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt dividends must still be disclosed on Schedule 5. The China subsidiary's dividend distribution is subject to Chinese withholding tax of 10% under the Cross-Strait Agreement; the Taiwan SPV may claim a foreign tax credit only to offset Taiwan tax on that income, which is generally nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile Article 42 exempt dividends: payor name, tax ID, amount, date paid, and shareholding percentage. Document 12-month holding period and direct investment qualification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach China subsidiary's dividend resolution, Chinese tax withholding certificate, and China Tax Residency Certificate for the subsidiary. The Chinese WHT is a final cost unless a foreign tax credit can be used against other Taiwan-source income (normally unavailable to a pure SPV).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 17 Line 13 / Box 13 (Net Taxable Income before Loss Carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute taxable income after adding back non-deductible expenses: penalties, retained earnings surtax, and entertainment over statutory limits. A pure holding SPV may report a tax loss if operating expenses exceed nil revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax losses are available only to the Taiwan-resident entity and may be subject to continuity-of-business review if the shareholding structure changes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct prior unrelieved tax losses within the 10-year statutory carryforward period, subject to the continuity of business activity test and proper return filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward benefits remain available if the SPV continually files returns and maintains its status as a Taiwan-resident company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the Alternative Minimum Tax (basic tax) at 12% to taxable income plus preferential deductions. Exempt dividend income under Article 42 generally does not trigger AMT because it is derived from qualifying profit-seeking enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: AMT applies to the Taiwan-resident SPV; non-resident shareholders are not subject to Taiwan AMT on dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report all non-taxable income including Article 42 exempt dividends and capital surplus. Link total to the exempt income memorandum account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The China subsidiary's dividends must be clearly traced from source to the memorandum account for future distribution to shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 20 / Shareholders' Equity and Undistributed Earnings
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report retained earnings components: legal reserve, special reserve, accumulated deficit, and distributable surplus. The 5% undistributed earnings surtax is assessed on the balance after income tax and legal reserve.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Draft distribution resolutions carefully to control the retained earnings surtax base; dividends paid in subsequent year can avoid current-year surtax but remain taxable to the recipient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: File within 10 days after dividend distribution to any non-resident shareholder, reporting gross dividends and the applicable withholding tax rate (21% statutory or 10% under the Cross-Strait Agreement).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Before using the 10% rate, submit to the Taiwan tax authority the application for reduced withholding, the Chinese shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate, and a beneficial ownership declaration. Without such approval, withhold at 21% and the non-resident may file a refund claim.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 3% per month of assessed tax for the first 30 days, then 0.5% per month thereafter, capped at 15% of unpaid tax. Non-payment surcharge: 1% every 2 days up to 30 days. Understatement or fraud penalties up to 3 times underpaid tax under Article 110; responsible person may face travel bans. Even a nil return must be filed timely to avoid penalties on the imputed minimum.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit a completed 'Application for Withholding at Reduced Rate' plus the non-resident shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from China, audited financial statements or proof of beneficial ownership, and a statement of eligibility under the Cross-Strait Agreement to the Taiwan National Taxation Bureau before the dividend payment date. Upon approval, the SPV withholds at 10%. If approval is not obtained in time, withhold at 21% and the non-resident shareholder may claim a refund within the statutory limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident: 20% statutory; reduced to 10% under the Cross-Strait Agreement. Interest paid to a non-resident: 20% statutory; reduced to 10% under the Cross-Strait Agreement (subject to beneficial ownership and anti-abuse provisions).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: TWD 50 million in aggregate annual related-party transactions for mandatory Local File preparation; small business exemption applies where annual operating revenue is below TWD 30 million, but a pure holding SPV must nevertheless maintain a TP report if intercompany loans, service fees, or guarantee fees exceed TWD 10 million or if the tax authority requests documentation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not have a separate ESR law, but the Income Tax Act (Articles 12-6-1, 43-1, 43-3) and the Cross-Strait Agreement's Limitation-on-Benefits provision require the SPV to demonstrate real business purpose, local management, employees/office, independent decision-making, and actual exercise of shareholder rights. A mailbox company used merely to route dividends to the Chinese parent may be disregarded, with the 10% treaty rate denied and the 21% statutory rate retroactively imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting exempt dividend income from the tax return, fabricating deductible expenses, using sham loans to distribute retained earnings without withholding, or understating the retained earnings surtax base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 110 Income Tax Act: fine of up to 3 times the underpaid tax; Tax Collection Act Article 62: imprisonment for 1-7 years and fine up to TWD 30 million; travel ban imposed under Article 24 for unpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly liable for the underpaid tax; serious fraud may lead to imprisonment for the actual decision-maker; courts may pierce the corporate veil to hold directors personally liable for restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse (紙上公司)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without a physical office, employees, board meetings, or bank accounts in Taiwan; functioning solely as a dividend pass-through for the Chinese parent without substantive investment-management activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority disregards the entity and reattributes income to the beneficial owner; 21% WHT imposed retroactively with penalties up to 3 times underpaid tax; company may be deregistered for false declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for the differential tax if the entity lacks assets; travel bans and civil restitution orders can be imposed; criminal liability under the Company Act for false registrations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Beneficial Ownership Deficiency (洗錢防制缺失)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file beneficial ownership information with the company registry; failing to identify the ultimate Chinese parent; routing dividends through layered bank accounts without enhanced due diligence; wire transfers to sanctioned parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money Laundering Control Act: fine of TWD 1-20 million for AML/CFT violations; criminal penalties up to 5 years imprisonment and fine up to TWD 10 million; suspension of bank operations possible.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability on directors and AML officers for intentional or grossly negligent BO filing failures; travel bans and asset freeze orders; civil liability for facilitated money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure (移轉訂價文據缺失)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in intercompany management fees, interest-free loans, guarantees, or IP royalties without an arm's length TP report; failure to file the related-party transaction disclosure form (Form 16) with the annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment plus penalty of 1x to 2.5x underpaid tax; failure to produce TP documentation may lead to estimated assessment with penalty up to 3x; late filing correction fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are liable for maintaining contemporaneous documentation; intentional manipulation of intercompany pricing may lead to personal joint liability and imprisonment for tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Applying the 10% Cross-Strait reduced rate without TRC or beneficial ownership approval; failing to withhold statutory 21% on dividends or 20% on royalties/interest; late Form 31 filing; distributing dividends while withholding tax was collected but not paid to the treasury.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding agent liable for uncollected tax plus penalty of 1x-3x; collected but unpaid: penalty 1x-2x; late Form 31 penalties of TWD 3,750-45,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible person in charge of withholding is jointly liable under Article 25-1 if the entity cannot pay; false documentation for reduced WHT may trigger forgery and tax evasion charges with up to 7 years imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Retained Earnings Surtax Evasion (未分配盈餘規避)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manipulating net income to avoid the 5% undistributed earnings surtax; mischaracterizing dividends as loan repayments or capital redemptions; distributing dividends in kind at artificially low values; incurring non-business expenses to reduce distributable surplus.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Surtax assessed under Article 66-9 at 5%; penalty up to 3 times the underpaid surtax; interest accrues at postal savings rates; memorandum account compliance failures carry separate penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for false equity declarations; if the SPV cannot pay, responsible persons face personal liability and travel bans.
